        How trade-in works
        How trade-in works
        1. Upgrade and save
        Accept your estimated trade-in value, buy your new device at the current price, and receive your delivery.
        2. Prepare device
        Sign out of all accounts linked to your old device, and factory reset it to erase your personal information.
        3. Ship within 30 days
        Print your shipping label, package your old device, and drop it off at any UPS location within 30 days of receiving your new device.
        4. Get your rebate
        After we receive your trade-in device, we'll verify it within 10 business days. Once verified, you'll receive your trade-in value as an Amazon.com Gift Card to your Amazon account for immediate use.

        About this item

        • DO MORE WITHOUT OPENING YOUR PHONE: Wait less and do more on the cover screen of your Galaxy Z Flip8. Use FlexWindow to tackle even more AI tasks with your smart phone closed so you can focus more on living in the moment.
        • FLEX YOUR PHONE. LOCK YOUR VIDEO¹: All you need for the perfect photoshoot is your Galaxy Z Flip8 phone. Simply go hands-free and grab amazing pics at any angle or get hands-on and lock in for Super Steady Video.¹
        • WORLD’S LIGHTEST, THINNEST FLIP²: Flip what you know about what compact can do. Galaxy Z Flip8 packs premium features and impressive power into the world’s lightest and thinnest flip phone.²
        • ICONIC. JUST LIKE YOU: Everyone has their signature shade — find yours with Galaxy Z Flip8. Choose between Pink, Graphite or Cream, and you have a smartphone that feels like it was designed with your style in mind.

        • What are the key features of Galaxy Z Flip8?

          Galaxy Z Flip8 delivers a lightweight, foldable experience. It is our lightest and thinnest Flip ever at 180 grams and 6.1 millimeters. The lightweight design means you can carry it comfortably in your hand or pocket throughout the day.

        • What is the difference between Galaxy Z Flip7 and Galaxy Z Flip8?

          If you value a slim, foldable design, the Galaxy Flip8 is a compelling upgrade choice. It is 8 grams lighter than the Galaxy Flip7 and featurees and elevated camera system thanks to tools like Photo Assist, Super Steady and Flip Shot.

        • I’m switching to Galaxy for the first time. How easy is it?

          The excitement of finding your perfect foldable phone can also bring up anxiety about making the switch from iPhone. Bring over photos, contacts and passwords. Share files and encrypt messages in a way you’re used to. And do it all on Galaxy Z Flip8.

        • How durable is Galaxy Z Flip8?

          Galaxy Z Flip8 is fortified with materials that strengthen the device for long-lasting durability. The Armor Aluminum frame provides enhanced protection for the device's internal components and exterior edges without adding excessive bulk.

        • Can I customize Galaxy Flip8's cover screen?

          Yes you can customize Galaxy Flip8's cover screen to match your style and do more without having to unfold the device. You can also view your personalized insights directly on FlexWindow with Now Brief.

        Product Description

        Galaxy Z Flip8 redefines what a compact foldable can do. First off, it’s the lightest and thinnest flip phone in the world², with a profile that flexes between ultimate pocketability and a super-slim canvas.

        When closed, the convenient edge-to-edge cover screen lets you access your favorite apps with a tap. FlexWindow also brings calendar alerts, quick replies and AI-driven suggestions front and center the moment that you need them.

        Flip it open and the phone becomes your portable content studio. Use the 50MP main camera in FlexMode to capture shots hands-free. Or go hands-on and film memories on the move while Super Steady Video¹ locks in to smoothly capture the action.

        Galaxy Z Flip8 flexes to your life, keeping you in the moment and ready for anything.

        Product Description

        Galaxy Z Flip8 redefines what a compact foldable can do. First off, it’s the lightest and thinnest flip phone in the world², with a profile that flexes between ultimate pocketability and a super-slim canvas.

        When closed, the convenient edge-to-edge cover screen lets you access your favorite apps with a tap. FlexWindow also brings calendar alerts, quick replies and AI-driven suggestions front and center the moment that you need them.

        Flip it open and the phone becomes your portable content studio. Use the 50MP main camera in FlexMode to capture shots hands-free. Or go hands-on and film memories on the move while Super Steady Video¹ locks in to smoothly capture the action.

        Galaxy Z Flip8 flexes to your life, keeping you in the moment and ready for anything.
